title: Momentum: Persistent Dynamics for Video World Models
abstract: Video world models must capture how a scene evolves beyond the current camera view to generate consistent observations when its content reappears. Existing approaches rely on observation history, static point clouds, or image caches constructed from past frames. These representations are often expensive and, more importantly, cannot update dynamic scene content outside the field of view: generated vehicles and pedestrians may be forgotten after leaving the field of view or reappear in physically inaccurate states. We represent an evolving scene through synchronized videos from reference-camera rigs, each comprising eight cameras that jointly cover the surrounding scene. We connect these rigs in a graph and propagate video generation between neighboring rigs to coordinate scene dynamics across locations and time. We introduce Momentum, a two-stage pipeline: WorldUpdate jointly generates reference-camera videos as a shared memory of scene dynamics, and WorldInteract grounds camera-controlled video generation in this evolving memory, allowing moving content to remain represented outside the target view and reappear consistently. To support training and evaluation, we develop a CARLA pipeline that captures synchronized videos from reference camera rigs and a moving target camera, together with an evaluation framework measuring consistency within the generated world state and the target observations.Experiments on generated street scenes show that grounding target videos in scene dynamics generated by Momentum improves dynamic scene consistency by 126.2% in unseen scenes over static image conditioning, while also improving visual fidelity. Our models and source code will be made publicly available.

analysis.sourceNote: 2026-10-20事后阅读全文并用于10月18日补刊，不是当日抓取快照。依据exact version 2610.23423v1 (17 pages)，全文文本与关键图表已核验。数字均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。Code: promised.
analysis.ideaZh: Momentum将world dynamics放进与目标相机分离的同步8-view rig视频graph，再用其驱动target generation。作者报告CARLA unseen town端到端SCS-dyn从0.084升至0.190，说明离屏动态grounding的价值；该分数是语义mask重叠，既不是identity/物理正确率，也尚无真实场景dynamic rollout验证。
analysis.motivationZh: 静态image/point caches只能记住过去外观，无法使离开相机视野的车辆和行人继续演化，并在再次被观察时保持同步动态。
analysis.methodZh: Momentum把world state表示成空间graph上的panoramic rigs，每rig八个同步camera videos。WorldUpdate由Cosmos2.5 multi-view DiT共同生成rig八视图，再按BFS将邻rig video经depth reproject传播；WorldInteract以时间对齐的generated reference video同时提供geometric warp与semantic conditioning，沿指定target camera轨迹生成观察。
methodFlow: 以空间分布的8-camera panoramic rigs建立graph并准备静态首帧和depth/camera
WorldUpdate共同生成每rig的同步多视图视频
按graph BFS将已生成邻rig的视频depth-unproject并reproject到待生成rig
WorldInteract检索nearby rigs，按target时间采集video warp与chunk-start semantic refs
沿target trajectory autoregressive生成观察，同一world rollout可复用于其他camera轨迹
analysis.experimentsZh: CARLA六towns、每setting每town20training sessions，seen/unseen两test各30sessions；300帧/10fps，up to4rigs。Cosmos2.5-2B target704×1280/77帧chunk，WorldUpdate192×352/29帧chunk；动态端到端从static初帧启动，real MARS仅检查static baseline。 作者报告端到端seen SCS-dyn0.198对DGWM-image0.086；unseen0.190对0.084。 (Table 4, p. 8) 作者报告GTreference的unseen4-rig DGWM PSNR21.94、SCS-dyn0.230，static-model image20.27/0.081。 (Table 2, p. 7) 作者报告unseen WorldUpdate staticness gap0.234，低于persistent frozen baseline0.593，但PSNR/SCS-dyn反而较低。 (Table 5, p. 17) 对照范围：将SWM-inspired static、同模型video输入、经过dynamic训练与完整Momentum逐步比较；GTsource数1vs3与single/multi-rig也覆盖。缺少真实dynamic训练/测试、强entity-plan baseline统一比较、跨trajectory identity指标及大graph闭环一致性评估。 消融与诊断：同步video训练比单换输入更关键；多source在unseen帮助、seen未全面提升。WorldUpdate单视图/多视图与frozen对照揭示静态metric偏好；没有严格证明BFS图环路的全局一致性或成本摊销规模。
analysis.insightZh: 主要新意是将持续动态状态与observer分离的multi-rig video graph和两阶段生成机制；不只是给video更多历史帧。它提供spatiotemporal state组织方案而非显式3D几何新表示；外部SWM比较仅作者报告static任务，dynamic贡献的实验证据仍是CARLA与自建metrics。
analysis.evidenceZh: 每个state rig八camera同步视频，WorldUpdate多视图注意力与邻rig reprojection按BFS传播，WorldInteract独立读取完成的rollout。 (Sec. 3.4, Fig. 2, pp. 4, 6-7); 作者报告unseen-town端到端Momentum SCS-dyn0.190，对同dynamic模型image conditioning0.084，PSNR22.98对22.44。 (Table 4, p. 8; Sec. 4, p. 9); 给GT reference video时unseen4-rig DGWM SCS-dyn0.230，static-model image0.081、video0.112。 (Table 2, p. 7); SCS-dyn对SAM3.1的vehicle/pedestrian/person/bicycle/animal类别union masks算IoU，每2fps；不核对instance identity。 (Appendix B.2, pp. 15-16); WorldUpdate的frozen-frame baseline在unseen PSNR31.88、SCS-dyn0.228，MultiRig为25.99/0.097，但staticness gap降至0.234对0.593。 (Appendix C.1, Table 5, p. 17)
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 可具体借鉴到dynamic3D scene generation的状态与观察解耦、多view动态监督以及offscreen memory，而非仅增加历史帧。该工作自身输出videos、没有editable3D；以明确transfer进入video雷达，暂不当作通用world模型或真实物理突破。
analysis.caveatZh: Sec. 1, p. 3：WorldUpdate增加独立inference成本，多个target轨迹共享rollout才可摊销。; Appendix C.1, p. 17：静止rig下PSNR、LPIPS与SCS-dyn奖励冻结；动态准确性与运动量须共同解读。; Sec. 3.2, p. 5：训练reference仅在target距rig25m内更新，外侧重复旧帧。; dynamic证据均为CARLA，真实MARS只支持static baseline，不等于sim-to-real动态泛化。; SCS为类别union masks，不能验证instance identity、速度、碰撞、因果或守恒。; BFS单向传播可能累积错误与graph回环冲突，未证明任意规模可扩展；不是物理simulation。; explicit geometry/可编辑3D资产不输出，3D主线迁移限于multi-view dynamics监督和共享world-state组织。
